name: Dr. Umesh Koyande
content: I have had the opportunity to observe Farhan Sayed through various academic initiatives, innovation programs, and technical competitions, and he has always impressed me with his enthusiasm and dedication. Farhan is someone who is always eager to learn and explore new ideas. He actively participates in projects and hackathons, taking on challenges with confidence and a problem-solving mindset. During his involvement in the Smart India Hackathon journey, he demonstrated strong commitment, teamwork, and the ability to work effectively under pressure. Competing at a national level among thousands of participants from across the country further highlighted his determination, resilience, and ability to perform in a highly competitive environment. What I appreciate most about Farhan is his willingness to go beyond what is expected. He consistently seeks opportunities to improve his skills, contribute to meaningful projects, and learn from every experience. His positive attitude, curiosity, and perseverance make him a promising young professional. I am confident that Farhan will continue to grow and achieve success in his career. I wish him all the best in his future endeavors and would gladly recommend him for opportunities that allow him to showcase his potential.

name: Dr. Geeta Sahu
content: I am delighted to recommend Farhan Sayed, an exceptionally talented and hardworking student with outstanding technical and problem-solving skills. His passion for coding, innovation, and continuous learning has consistently distinguished him from his peers. A remarkable achievement in his academic journey is winning the prestigious Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 at the all-India national level. This accomplishment reflects his ability to develop impactful solutions and perform exceptionally under challenging conditions.
